event.response: 'Pell went up to Censer Hill foundry at first light and should have been back by mid-morning,' says Wren. 'Nobody has seen them since. The short way in is the drain culvert, and the rising river will close it at about watch 34; after that you go the long way round. Please. Go and look.'

perceptions.text: Barges nose into reed-fringed piles. The Serewater is high and brown. Upriver, the derelict foundry on Censer Hill stands above the willows. The Oar's sign creaks over one door, Nera's herbs hang in another, and the shrine porch faces the water.
Wren stands with one hand shading their eyes, watching the way to Censer Hill foundry.
